engineeringGuide.title: Engineering Guide: Orientation, Locking & Decision Matrix
engineeringGuide.lede: Follow IDGen's technical decision matrix to choose the correct holder configuration based on card dimensions, retention requirements, and application environment:

orientationCard.title: Vertical vs Horizontal Holders
orientationCard.description: Selecting between portrait and landscape holders depends strictly on your printed card artwork layout.
orientationCard.verticalDesc: Industry standard for student IDs, corporate employee passes, and hospital credentials. Hangs vertically from top-center slot.
orientationCard.horizontalDesc: Standard for conferences, summits, visitor badges, and cards featuring horizontal logos or dual-photo credentials.

lockingCard.title: Standard Slip-In vs 4-Side Lock
lockingCard.description: Match the retention level to physical movement intensity and badge replacement cost.
lockingCard.dropInDesc: Open top/side entry allowing quick card extraction when cards must be tapped or scanned repeatedly throughout the day.
lockingCard.fourSideDesc: Four perimeter snap tabs capture card edges. Virtually impossible for cards to slip out accidentally during running or active factory work.

engineeringGuide.decisionStepsLede: Click each step below to view the engineered recommendation for your specific deployment:

decisionSteps.q: Step 1 • What is your card orientation?
decisionSteps.a: Portrait → Vertical Holder (V-Series) | Landscape → Horizontal Holder (H-Series)
decisionSteps.detail: Match the physical card orientation to avoid awkward tilted display.

decisionSteps.q: Step 2 • Do you need extra retention security?
decisionSteps.a: Standard everyday → V-1 / H-1 | Active movement → V-2 / H-2 (4-Side Lock)
decisionSteps.detail: Four-side locking tabs physically capture card corners, preventing accidental slippage during daily commutes or factory shifts.

decisionSteps.q: Step 3 • Is your card using a chemical sticker format?
decisionSteps.a: Chemical dome / sticker format → V-3 Chemical Sticker Holder
decisionSteps.detail: Specially formulated recessed frame providing sealed protection for resin dome badges.

decisionSteps.q: Step 4 • Is this for executive or VIP leadership presentation?
decisionSteps.a: Executive appearance → Metal ID Holder or CV-1 Crystal Optical Acrylic
decisionSteps.detail: Machined aluminum alloy or diamond-beveled crystal acrylic for commanding corporate presence.

decisionSteps.q: Step 5 • Do you need lanyard hardware attachments?
decisionSteps.a: Holder to Lanyard connection → Precision Chrome Fish Hook
decisionSteps.detail: Full 360-degree rotational swivel with spring gate that snaps into any 20mm slot.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.lede: Common questions regarding card holder models, fittings, attachments, and order turnaround:

items.q: What types of ID card holders does IDGen provide?
items.a: IDGen provides different ID card holder options including vertical and horizontal holders, four-side-lock holders, chemical-sticker holders, crystal holders, metal holders and lanyard attachment options. The appropriate holder depends on the card orientation, dimensions, retention requirement and how the card will be worn.

items.q: How do I choose between a vertical and horizontal ID card holder?
items.a: Choose the holder according to the orientation of your printed card. A portrait card requires a vertical holder, while a landscape card requires a horizontal holder. IDGen's V-series holders are designed for vertical cards and H-series holders for horizontal cards.

items.q: What is the difference between a standard holder and a four-side-lock holder?
items.a:
A standard ID card holder allows the card to slide in and out more easily, making it convenient when cards need to be removed or replaced frequently.
A four-side-lock holder secures the card from multiple sides, making it more difficult to remove the card accidentally or intentionally during normal use. This type of holder is particularly suitable for school students, where preventing students from easily taking out or losing their ID cards can be important.
For schools and other applications where the card needs to remain securely inside the holder, a four-side-lock holder can provide an additional level of card retention compared with a standard holder.

items.q: What size ID card fits IDGen's standard holders?
items.a: The standard holder range is designed around the specified CR80-format card dimensions, including the 86 × 54 mm format used by the V-series and the corresponding horizontal orientation for H-series holders. Card and holder dimensions should always be confirmed before a bulk order.

items.q: Are ID card holders made from virgin plastic?
items.a: IDGen's standard holder range includes holders made from virgin-grade polymer materials. Specific material and construction can vary between holder models, so the material specification should be confirmed for the selected model before ordering.

items.q: Can an ID card holder be attached directly to a lanyard?
items.a: Yes. Suitable ID card holders can be connected to lanyards using compatible attachment hardware such as fish hooks, clips or other fittings. IDGen can coordinate the holder, attachment and custom printed lanyard as a complete wearable setup.

items.q: Can ID card holders be supplied with hooks or clips?
items.a: Yes. IDGen provides attachment options such as swivel fish hooks and other suitable clips for connecting holders to lanyards. The attachment should be selected according to the holder's slot and the required lanyard configuration.

items.q: Can I order ID card holders separately without ID cards?
items.a: Yes. ID card holders can be ordered separately when an organization already has its ID cards or wants to source the accessories independently. IDGen can also supply holders as part of a complete card, holder, hook and lanyard setup.

items.q: Can IDGen supply complete ID card holder and lanyard sets?
items.a: Yes. IDGen can coordinate a complete wearable identification setup consisting of a printed ID card, holder, attachment hook or clip and custom printed lanyard. This allows organizations to source the required identification components together.

items.q: Are ID card holders suitable for schools, companies and events?
items.a: Yes. Different holder configurations can be used for student, employee, staff, visitor, membership, conference and event identification. The appropriate model depends on the card orientation, retention requirement and intended environment.

items.q: What is a four-side-lock holder useful for?
items.a:
A four-side-lock holder is particularly useful for school students and other users who need their ID card to remain securely inside the holder during regular movement and daily activities. The locking points around the card help reduce the possibility of the card being accidentally removed or falling out.
For schools, this can be useful because students are less likely to easily take the ID card out of the holder compared with a standard holder.

items.q: What information should I provide when ordering ID card holders?
items.a: Provide the card dimensions, portrait or landscape orientation, required quantity, preferred holder style, retention requirement and attachment requirement. If you already have the ID card or a holder sample, providing its dimensions or a physical sample can help IDGen confirm compatibility before bulk production.
